name: WidgetTopRow
description: Compact header row used at the top of container / miner widgets — shows the title, one badge per alarm category you pass, and the current power reading (or an error tooltip)

props.name: alarms
props.description: Alarm category badges, in display order. Categories with no items render nothing

fields.name: title
fields.description: Category label; the tooltip heading reads `<title> issues`

fields.name: items
fields.description: Active alerts in this category; the badge is hidden when empty
